description: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. — U.S. Senate candidate Hallie Shoffner today announced Arkansas Voices, a statewide listening and engagement tour that will take her to communities across Arkansas to hear directly from voters. title: Hallie Shoffner Announces Arkansas Voices, a Statewide Listening and Engagement Tour — Hallie Shoffner for Senate 2026
